## Real Liquid Glass
- **Light really bends now:** the player, the tab bar, the tab blob, menus, the side panel and the toast are clear glass. What scrolls underneath is bent and slightly split into colours at their rounded edges, like a thick glass pane, instead of only being blurred
- **Clear instead of milky:** the bars are barely tinted and hardly blurred, so covers and text show through. Text and icons on the glass carry a soft shadow and stay readable over anything
- **Light inside the glass:** a glow along the top edge and a faint one along the bottom; the bright rim still turns with the mouse on the PC and with the tilt of the phone
- **Light mode:** the same clear glass with a thin white veil instead of a thick white layer
- **Where:** Android app, Windows app and Chrome/Edge show the bend. Safari, Firefox and the Linux app cannot bend what lies behind a pane, so there the glass stays frosted with the same rim and light

The Liquid Glass pictures on the website were updated too.

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
